Answer: A
Reason: Figure 3 demonstrates extensive, diffuse bilateral alveolar infiltrates (whiteout) with a normal-sized cardiac silhouette, which is the hallmark radiographic presentation of Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) rather than cardiogenic pulmonary edema. The progression from patchy opacities to this severe bilateral involvement is consistent with the evolution of ARDS.
